caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a man in left profile. The bust is stylized, combining features of a man's head and upper torso with elements resembling architectural ornamentation. The man's face and neck are rendered in tones of brown, with black, curly hair and sideburns, and he has pronounced facial features including a large nose and ear. He is wearing a high-collared coat or uniform in shades of greyish-blue, with some areas showing wear or texture indications in lighter colors, and a white cravat at the neck. There is a small orange-gold medal or decoration on his chest. The lower part of the bust transitions into a sculptural, scroll-like design with acanthus leaves, primarily in different shades of grey; parts of this ornamentation are only outlined and not fully colored in. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenes.
title: Figurehead
